questions.q: Why did gold prices rise when Federal Reserve officials considered a rate hike?
o: Dip buying increased because rising inflation expectations catalyzed a bid in gold.
The central bank purchased physical gold to replace Treasury bond holdings.
Lower interest rates reduced the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets.
Commercial lenders flooded the market with liquidity from reverse repo auctions.
questions.e: Higher odds of monetary tightening drove gold prices higher on dip buying as inflation expectations rose. This shows how market participants react to price surges by seeking alternative assets.
